decision.C1: rejected: cost per successful task rose 55% (34% to 79%) because the volatile block is rewritten every turn (cache-read share 0.97 -> 0.85); a single memory change per session does not repay it.
decision.C2: rejected: cost per successful task fell 30% (19% to 40%) and the cache-read share rose 0.85 -> 0.96, but completion was not noninferior in the pre-registered confirmatory run (-7.4 points, -15.0 to +0.6) and duplicate create-task writes rose (218 vs 168 failing turns with two identical writes), a duplicate-effect regression that ADR-0094 clause 21 forbids. The exploratory run had pointed the other way (+11.4 points, -3.2 to +25.0).

experiment: C1 stable-prefix layout and C2 history hysteresis (prompt-cache stability)
finding: In long sessions of repeated create-task turns, gpt-6-luna re-requested the same create-task in about a quarter of turns under both arms (an observed duplicate-effect failure class worth its own stratum).

hypotheses.C1: Moving the volatile sections (memories, Routines, date) out of the system prompt into the current turn's message keeps the cached history across a memory change, lowering cost per successful task by at least 15% with completion noninferior.
hypotheses.C2: Trimming a saturated history down to 16 exchanges (96,000 tokens) instead of dropping one exchange per turn keeps the cached conversation prefix, lowering cost per successful task by at least 15% with completion noninferior (-2 points).

method: In-process AgentRuntime sessions on one thread each with the evaluation ceiling. Stratum sat: 24 short completed exchanges seeded without a provider, then 10 real turns that each ask for one task to be created and a final probe about the task created three turns earlier; arms base vs hyst. Stratum mem: empty history, 10 memories, one changed from turn 6, same turns; arms base vs stable (volatile data prepended to the current message, request-local). Success is exact: one create-task write with the asked title, or the probe title literally in the reply. Paired by session (same script), randomized arm order, session-cluster bootstrap.
provider: openai gpt-6-luna, effort low (the Anthropic test key has no credit, so the Anthropic arms could not run; OpenAI caches prefixes automatically and bills cache writes at 1.25x, so both mechanisms apply)

confirmatory_C2.pre_registered: 60 sessions, stratum sat only, same criteria
